narration: In a classroom by the window at Immortal Sect Fifth High School in Danxia City, a handsome young man pulled out his slim, jade-like smartphone and opened his personal interface to update his data. With the new semester just beginning, the homeroom teacher was checking each student's cultivation progress during the holiday break. Chen Mobai edited the necessary updates. After connecting to the school's network, he was about to submit his personal panel to the teacher when a voice came from beside him.

dialogues.speaker: Deskmate
dialogues.line: Whoa, you actually went into secluded cultivation during the holiday and broke through to the Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement?

dialogues.speaker: Chen Mobai
dialogues.line: We're not the same, you know. I have a True Spiritual Root. If I focus and work hard, my cultivation progress will undoubtedly be much faster than yours with that Pseudo Spiritual Root.

dialogues.speaker: Deskmate
dialogues.line: How can your Spiritual Root attributes qualify as a True Spiritual Root? It's so unfair!

narration: The homeroom teacher, standing at the podium, had finished reviewing everyone's status panels. A rare smile broke through his typically stern expression. He then called out each student who had shown improvement, praising them by name. Chen Mobai was among those commended. The teacher's praise caused the two beautiful classmates in front of him to turn around, and Chen Mobai couldn't help but puff out his chest, a smug look spreading across his face. Reaching the Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement realm placed him firmly within the top twenty of the class. Reaching the Sixth-Stage Qi Refinement realm would likely make the four top-tier Dao Academies unattainable, but he could still aspire to Second-Tier Dao Academies. Entering a Dao Academy after the entrance exam would exempt him from conscription into the Immortal Sect's frontier wars for at least a decade, potentially giving him time to achieve Foundation Establishment.

dialogues.speaker: Chai Deyun
dialogues.line: Mm, not bad. Many of you have made progress during the holidays.

dialogues.speaker: Chai Deyun
dialogues.line: Finally, I want to give special commendation to Song Zheng and Yan Bingxuan. I never imagined I'd live to see two students reach the late stages of Qi Refinement under my tutelage.

narration: With no time to be picky, he spotted an empty cultivation room with its door ajar and rushed inside. Chen Mobai swiped his electronic student ID from his phone against the reader at the chamber's entrance. The 'Vacant' sign on the electronic display vanished instantly, and the door began to close slowly. A classmate who arrived a moment too late cursed under his breath and scrambled toward another empty cultivation room. Their urgency was understandable. Spiritual energy was incredibly scarce. After six thousand years of exploitation by the Immortal Sect, Diyuan Star's resources were nearly depleted.

narration: Within the territories occupied by the Thirty-Six Grotto-Heavens and Seventy-Two Blessed Lands, all Spiritual Veins and primordial qi had been nationalized. The residual spiritual energy lingering in the environment was barely sufficient for cultivators' basic breathing and meditation. To cultivate using concentrated spiritual energy, practitioners had to pay the Immortal Sect in Merit Points. First-Tier Low-Grade Earth Vein Spiritual Energy delivered to one's Cave Abode cost ten Merit Points per month. As a Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement cultivator, Chen Mobai found First-Tier Low-Grade spiritual energy inadequate for his needs. First-Tier Mid-Grade Earth Vein Spiritual Energy cost 20 Merit Points per month. First-Tier High-Grade Earth Vein Spiritual Energy, on the other hand, required 40 Merit Points per month. For Chen Mobai, the amount of First-Tier Mid-Grade Spiritual Energy was only enough to stabilize his cultivation and make barely noticeable progress. If he wanted to advance rapidly, First-Tier High-Grade was the better choice. Of course, Second-Tier or even Third-Tier Earth Vein Spiritual Energy would be ideal. But that was merely wishful thinking. Sensing the spiritual energy concentration in his approximately three-square-meter cultivation chamber beginning to rise, Chen Mobai opened the spiritual energy measurement app on his phone. After waiting nearly a minute, the reading finally stabilized.
